title: Legacy 'Parts Manager' users become 'Parts Manager' after migration
custom_preconds:
1. Migration to the new roles is complete.
  2. At least one existing 'Parts Manager' user is present.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Settings > Staff and find a 'Parts Manager' user.
  2. Check the user's assigned role.
  3. Go to Settings > Roles & Permissions and find that role's row.
  4. Look at the role's read-only Permission Summary (eye icon).
custom_expected:
The user's role is 'Parts Manager'.

The role's permissions match the expected set for that role.

The 'Parts Manager' role is editable (it has a pencil icon).
evidence: Live roles API: "Parts Manager" exists, isEditable=true, 4 users, 31 perms.
